Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on a Sugar Land roadway when Driver 2, operating a vehicle in the adjacent
lane, began a lane change without confirming the lane was clear. The two vehicles made contact along their right and
left sides, respectively, with the force of the contact consistent with the damage observed on both vehicles. Driver 2
stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described it, and Driver 1's account was consistent with the physical
evidence at the scene. Photographs taken by the responding officer show damage that is lragely in line with a
sideswipe of this type. Two independent witnesses, who were stopped at a nearby traffic signal, gave statements
confirming the sequence of events. A Passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle and was identified at the
scene. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder, which is consistent with the mechanism of the collision as
described by all parties. No prior damage to the vehicle was known to the involved parties or observed by the
responding officer. Driver 1 was identified as a household member of the registered policyholder, who was not
present at the scene.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- occupants_listed: How many people does the police report list in the insured vehicle (Vehicle 1)? The rating is a whole number. Allowed: a whole number.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
